title: FlowConsole RuleFile v1alpha1
description: Canonical schema for a self-contained FlowConsole rule file.

apiVersion.title: API Version
apiVersion.description: Version of the FlowConsole rule file contract.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Top-level document kind. For this contract it is always RuleFile.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Non-empty list of self-contained rules declared in this file.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Stable identifier used for rule ids and let variable names.

nonEmptyString.title: Non-Empty String
nonEmptyString.description: String value that must not be empty.

stringArray.title: String Array
stringArray.description: Non-empty array of unique non-empty strings.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Severity level assigned to the rule result.

target.title: Target
target.description: Model projection against which the rule is evaluated. 'model' — architectural model from DSL/SDK source (to-be intent). 'actual' — model from code scanners, infra scanners, or imports (as-is reality). 'diff' — drift between model and actual.

sourceFamily.title: Source Family
sourceFamily.description: Source family used to narrow actual or diff projections.

entityType.title: Entity Type
entityType.description: Type of projection items selected by a selector.

changeKind.title: Change Kind
changeKind.description: Kind of change in the diff projection that an element rule with target=diff can match.

textMatcher.title: Text Matcher
textMatcher.description: Matcher for textual fields such as name or technology. At least one matching strategy must be provided.

equals.title: Equals
equals.description: Requires the field to exactly match the provided string.

contains.title: Contains
contains.description: Requires the field to contain the provided substring.

matches.title: Matches
matches.description: Requires the field to match the provided regular expression.

propertyMatcher.title: Property Matcher
propertyMatcher.description: Matcher for a property value inside selector.properties.

equals.title: Equals
equals.description: Requires the property value to exactly match the provided string.

in.title: In
in.description: Requires the property value to be one of the provided values.

matches.title: Matches
matches.description: Requires the property value to match the provided regular expression.

selector.title: Selector
selector.description: Inline selector used by a rule to describe which entities it applies to.

entity.title: Entity
entity.description: Kind of projection items selected by this selector.

kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.description: Element or relationship kinds allowed by this selector.

tagsAny.title: Tags Any
tagsAny.description: At least one of these tags must be present on the selected entity.

tagsAll.title: Tags All
tagsAll.description: All of these tags must be present on the selected entity.

name.title: Name Matcher
name.description: Optional matcher applied to the entity name.

technology.title: Technology Matcher
technology.description: Optional matcher applied to the entity technology field.

sourceFamilies.title: Source Families
sourceFamilies.description: Optional source families used to narrow actual or diff entities inside the selector.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Map of property matchers keyed by property name.

where.title: Where
where.description: Rule Expression boolean predicate evaluated for each candidate entity matched by this selector.

elementOnlySelector.title: Element-Only Selector
elementOnlySelector.description: Selector constrained to elements entity type only.

nonDiffSelector.title: Non-Diff Selector
nonDiffSelector.description: Selector that forbids diffItems entity type.

diffOnlySelector.title: Diff-Only Selector
diffOnlySelector.description: Selector constrained to diffItems entity type only.

ruleBase.title: Rule Base
ruleBase.description: Common fields shared by all rule kinds.

id.title: Rule ID
id.description: Stable identifier of the rule. Must be unique within the file.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable rule name shown in UI and reports.

kind.title: Rule Kind
kind.description: Rule evaluation strategy. 'element' checks properties of elements, relationships, or diff items. 'flow' checks reachability and paths between elements.

target.title: Target
target.description: Projection against which this rule is defined.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Severity assigned when the rule fails.

blocking.title: Blocking
blocking.description: Whether a failing result should be treated as blocking in CI or enforcement flows.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional longer explanation of the intent of the rule.
examples: Critical services must not be isolated from the rest of the system.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the rule is enabled. Omitted value is normalized to true.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Free-form tags used to group and classify rules.

sourceFamilies.title: Source Families
sourceFamilies.description: Optional top-level source narrowing for actual or diff targets.

where.title: Where
where.description: Optional Rule Expression boolean predicate applied after the main selector for this rule kind.

let.title: Let
let.description: Map of named Rule Expression values computed before assert and exposed to message interpolation.

assert.title: Assert
assert.description: Required Rule Expression boolean that defines pass or fail for the rule.

message.title: Message
message.description: User-facing failure message. Supports interpolation of available bindings and let values.

elementRule.title: Element Rule
elementRule.description: Rule that checks properties of elements, relationships, or diff items within a subject set.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Selector that defines the entities evaluated by the rule.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Whether the rule is evaluated per matched item or over the aggregate selection.

changeKinds.title: Change Kinds
changeKinds.description: Optional list of diff change kinds. Only allowed when target is 'diff'.

flowRule.title: Flow Rule
flowRule.description: Rule that checks reachability and path constraints between two element selections.

target.description: Flow rules can only target 'model' or 'actual' projections.

from.title: From
from.description: Selector describing source elements of the candidate paths.

to.title: To
to.description: Selector describing destination elements of the candidate paths.

via.title: Via
via.description: Optional selector restricting which elements may appear inside candidate paths.

viaMode.title: Via Mode
viaMode.description: How the via selector constrains intermediate nodes. 'include' (default) requires all intermediate nodes to match; 'exclude' forbids any intermediate node from matching.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Whether assertions are evaluated per path or over the full path set.

maxDepth.title: Max Depth
maxDepth.description: Maximum traversal depth in edges allowed when searching for candidate paths.

allowCycles.title: Allow Cycles
allowCycles.description: Whether cyclic paths may be considered during path evaluation.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: Single self-contained rule. Must match exactly one supported rule kind.
